description:
We're TeamBa404 from Manila, three software engineers who care about agriculture. For Field Shift we built Ani, a web app that helps Filipino farmers read the season before they plant. It rates 14 crops month by month using 9 NASA data sources going back to 1981.

Our skills: full-stack web development, data science and agritech research.

Live app: https://nasa-ani-app.vercel.app

Demo: https://youtu.be/YuPpbB6L21w

Code: https://github.com/devmaniel/nasa-ani-app
